mapper.sql: WITH ics_class AS ( SELECT * FROM ics21_checklist_l_class LEFT OUTER JOIN ics22_checklist_l_class_company ON ( ics22_checklist_l_class_id = ics21_checklist_l_class_id AND ics22_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) ) INNER JOIN ics23_checklist_m_class ON ( ics23_checklist_l_class_id = ics21_checklist_l_class_id AND ics23_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ics24_checklist_m_class_company ON ( ics24_checklist_m_class_id = ics23_checklist_m_class_id AND ics24_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) ) WHERE ics21_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) AND ( ( COALESCE(ics21_use_yn,'true') = 'false' AND COALESCE(ics21_close_date,'1999-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(ics21_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) ) AND ( ( COALESCE(ics22_use_yn,'true') = 'false' AND COALESCE(ics22_close_date,'1999-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(ics22_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) ) AND ( ( COALESCE(ics23_use_yn,'true') = 'false' AND COALESCE(ics23_close_date,'1999-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(ics23_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) ) AND ( ( COALESCE(ics24_use_yn,'true') = 'false' AND COALESCE(ics24_close_date,'1999-12-31') >= #{stdDate} ) OR ( COALESCE(ics24_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) ) )

WITH chkList AS ( SELECT ics10.* , CASE WHEN sch22_confirmer_id IS NOT NULL THEN sch22_confirmer_id ELSE (CASE WHEN confirmer_type = '2' THEN cco.person_id ELSE (CASE WHEN org_confirmer_id IS NULL THEN cco.person_id ELSE org_confirmer_id END) END) END AS confirmer_id FROM (
SELECT * , ics21_checklist_l_class_nm AS ics10_check_l_class_nm , ics21_seq AS ics10_check_l_class_seq , ics23_checklist_m_class_nm AS ics10_check_m_class_nm , ics23_seq AS ics10_check_m_class_seq FROM ics10_checklist INNER JOIN ics_class ON ics23_checklist_m_class_id = ics10_checklist_m_class_id INNER JOIN ics11_checklist_company ON ( ics11_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics11_checklist_id = ics10_checklist_id ) INNER JOIN sch22_write_group ON sch22_write_group_id = ics11_write_group_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT sch02.* , f_get_confirmer_limit(person_id, #{stdDate}::date, '0020') AS org_confirmer_id FROM ( SELECT sch02_info_id , sch02_person_id person_id , emp00_kor_nm person_nm , emp00_org_code_id org_id , emp00_org_code_nm org_nm FROM sch02_share INNER JOIN getPerson(#{companyId}, #{stdDate}) ON emp00_person_id = sch02_person_id WHERE sch02_company_id = #{companyId} AND sch02_share_cd = '1' AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN sch02_start_date AND COALESCE(sch02_close_date,'9999-12-31') UNION ALL SELECT sch02_info_id , emp00_person_id person_id , emp00_kor_nm person_nm , emp00_org_code_id org_id , emp00_org_code_nm org_nm FROM sch02_share INNER JOIN getPerson(#{companyId}, #{stdDate}) ON emp00_org_code_id = sch02_org_id WHERE sch02_company_id = #{companyId} AND sch02_share_cd = '2' AND #{stdDate}::date BETWEEN sch02_start_date AND COALESCE(sch02_close_date,'9999-12-31') AND emp00_trans_cd != '900' /*(900:퇴직)*/ AND emp00_title_cd != '900' /*(900:비상근)*/ AND COALESCE(emp00_non_stay_yn,'false') != 'true' AND emp00_kind_cd NOT IN ('40','99') /*(40:임시직/99:기타직)*/ ) sch02 ) emp ON sch02_info_id = sch22_write_group_id WHERE COALESCE(ics10_use_yn,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(ics11_use_yn,'false') = 'true' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp.person_id AND ( ( emp04_start_date > #{stdDate}::date ) OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date,'9999-12-31') < #{stdDate}::date ) ) ) ics10 , ( SELECT emp00_person_id person_id , COALESCE(sys01_ics_check_confirmer_type,'1') confirmer_type FROM getPerson(#{companyId}, #{stdDate}) INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = emp00_company_id WHERE emp00_trans_cd != '900' /*(900:퇴직)*/ AND emp00_grade_cd = '120' /*(120:준법감시인)*/ LIMIT 1 ) cco )

sql.if: AND CONCAT(ics10_check_l_class_nm, ics10_check_m_class_nm, ics10_content, org_nm, person_nm) ILIKE #{searchText}

mapper.select:
SELECT ics10_checklist_id AS checklist_id , ics10_check_l_class_nm AS check_l_class_name , ics10_check_m_class_nm AS check_m_class_name , COUNT(*) - SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ics15_fix_yn ,'false') != 'false' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS un_check_cnt , COUNT(*) - SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ics15_confirm_yn,'false') != 'false' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS un_confirm_cnt
WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY ics10_checklist_id , ics10_check_l_class_nm , ics10_check_m_class_nm

SELECT ics10_checklist_id AS checklist_id , ics10_content AS content FROM ics10_checklist INNER JOIN ics_class ON ics23_checklist_m_class_id = ics10_checklist_m_class_id WHERE ics10_checklist_id IN #{id} ORDER BY ics21_seq, ics23_seq, ics10_seq, ics10_content

SELECT ics10_checklist_id AS checklist_id , ics11_company_id AS company_id , ics10_content AS content , ics10_criterion AS criterion , ics10_seq AS seq , ics10_checklist_m_class_id AS checklist_m_class_id , ics21_checklist_l_class_id AS check_l_class_id , ics10_check_l_class_nm AS check_l_class_name , ics10_check_m_class_nm AS check_m_class_name , ics15_checklist_write_id AS checklist_write_id , CASE WHEN ics15_answer_cd IS NOT NULL THEN f_cdnm('AnswerCode', ics15_answer_cd, ics11_company_id, #{stdDate}) ELSE '' END ||CASE WHEN ics15_reason IS NOT NULL THEN ' ('||ics15_reason||')' ELSE '' END AS reason , org_nm AS org_name , person_id AS person_id , person_nm AS person_name , COALESCE(ics15_fix_yn,'false') = 'true' AS fix_yn , confirmer.emp00_kor_nm AS confirmer_name , COALESCE(ics15_confirm_yn,'false') = 'true' AS confirm_yn
LEFT JOIN getPerson(#{companyId}, #{stdDate}) confirmer ON confirmer.emp00_person_id = COALESCE(ics15_confirmer_id, confirmer_id) WHERE 1=1 AND ics10_checklist_id = #{checklistId}
AND COALESCE(ics15_fix_yn,'false') = 'false'
AND COALESCE(ics15_confirm_yn,'false') = 'false'
ORDER BY ics10_check_l_class_seq, ics10_check_m_class_seq, ics10_content, org_nm, person_nm
